# Integrate Medical Agents

The calls themselves: where they live, what they need in their headers, every operation, and one request written out in full.

## Hosts

- `https://api.eka.care` Production server
- `https://api.dev.eka.care` Development server

## Auth and headers

Get a token first: [Authentication](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/auth/getting-started).

- `agentAuth`: API key in the `x-agent-id` header.

Headers that some operations require:

- `x-sess-token`

## Read first

- [MedAssist Agent](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/agents/overview)

## Endpoints

3 operations, grouped by tag.

### Other

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | [`/med-assist/session`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/agents/create-session) | Create Session |
| `GET` | [`/med-assist/session/{session_id}`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/agents/get-session) | Get Session |
| `GET` | [`/med-assist/session/{session_id}/refresh`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/agents/refresh-session) | Refresh Session Token |

## One request in full

POST /med-assist/session, from [its page](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/agents/create-session).

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.eka.care/med-assist/session' \
  -H 'x-agent-id: <x-agent-id>'
```
